course_info.trial_description:
Hello! I’m excited to begin this English language learning journey with you. Let's take a moment to get to know each other and set some goals for your progress.

To start, could you tell me a bit about your current level of English proficiency? Are you a beginner, intermediate, or advanced learner? Understanding your level will help me tailor our approach to suit your needs.

Once we have an idea of where you are, we can establish clear and achievable goals for your learning journey. For example:

Building Vocabulary: Learn 10 new words each week and practice using them in sentences.
Improving Speaking Skills: Dedicate 10 minutes daily to speaking in English—whether with a partner, tutor, or even by recording yourself.
Mastering Grammar and Writing: Complete 2 grammar exercises each week and write a short essay each month.
Enhancing Listening and Comprehension: Listen to a 10-minute podcast or watch a show in English every day.
We can break these goals down into smaller, manageable steps, and I’ll be here to support you every step of the way. Do you want to focus more on conversational English, business English, or academic writing? Let me know what excites you most, and together we’ll create a personalized plan for success!

pro_course_detail.title: Business English
pro_course_detail.description: In this Business English course, students will develop essential communication skills for the professional world, with a particular focus on Public Relations. The course covers key areas such as business writing (emails, reports, press releases), corporate communication, and PR strategies for managing company image and public perception. Students will also practice negotiation techniques, language for business meetings and presentations, and effective networking in professional settings. Additionally, emphasis will be placed on cross-cultural communication, ensuring students are equipped to navigate diverse business environments. By the end of the course, learners will confidently use professional English to excel in business interactions, enhance their PR knowledge, and communicate effectively in a variety of real-world situations.

pro_course_detail.title: Bright Beginnings: English Adventures for Kids
pro_course_detail.description: In this Kids’ English course, students will learn English in a dynamic and interactive environment, designed specifically for young learners. The course will focus on developing speaking, listening, reading, and basic writing skills through games, songs, stories, and activities that keep children engaged and motivated. You will teach vocabulary, basic grammar, and simple sentence structures while helping children build confidence in using English for everyday situations. The course will also incorporate creative activities like arts and crafts, role-play, and group work to encourage communication in a fun and supportive setting. By the end of the course, children will have improved their ability to understand and speak basic English, setting a strong foundation for future language learning.

pro_course_detail.title: Chat & Connect: Mastering English Through Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
Hello! I’m excited to help you improve your English conversational skills. Let’s work together to make your spoken English more natural and confident.

To start, could you tell me a bit about your current speaking ability? Are you comfortable with basic conversations, or do you feel you need more practice with fluency or pronunciation? Knowing where you are will help me design a plan that meets your needs.

Once we have a better understanding of your level, we can set clear, achievable goals for your conversational practice, such as:

Daily Speaking Practice: Set aside 10-15 minutes every day to practice speaking in English—whether with a partner, tutor, or even by recording yourself.
Expanding Vocabulary: Learn new phrases and expressions that are commonly used in everyday conversations.
Improving Fluency: Practice having longer, uninterrupted conversations on various topics to increase your speaking flow.

Together, we can create a plan that’s engaging and fun, helping you feel more confident and fluent in English conversations. Let me know what you’d like to focus on most, and we’ll get started!

Do you want to improve your English? I have what it takes for you to get there. I am an expert in the following areas.
General English: Covering all four key language skills (reading, writing, speaking, and listening) to improve overall fluency.
Exam Preparation: Coaching students for exams in the local school.
Conversational English: Focusing on real-life communication, idioms, and cultural nuances.


My teaching methodology is student-centered, focusing on meeting individual needs while creating an engaging and supportive learning environment. I aim to develop students’ skills through a balanced approach that integrates;
Speaking Skills: Working on fluency, pronunciation, intonation, and accent reduction.
Listening and Reading Comprehension: Teaching strategies for improving understanding, speed, and accuracy.
Exam Preparation: In-depth coaching for standardized tests.
My teaching methods are;
1. Communicative Language Teaching (CLT): I prioritize real-life communication, encouraging students to practice English in context through conversations, role-plays, and debates.
2. Task-Based Learning (TBL): Lessons are built around tasks that simulate real-world situations, allowing students to apply language in practical scenarios.
3. Grammar and Vocabulary in Context: Instead of focusing on isolated grammar drills, I introduce grammar and vocabulary within meaningful contexts to enhance retention and practical use.
4. Flipped Classroom Approach: I often provide learning materials for students to explore at home (like videos or articles), then use class time to practice and discuss the content, making our lessons more interactive.
5. Technology Integration: I incorporate digital tools, such as language apps, interactive quizzes, and online platforms, to make learning more dynamic and accessible.
6. Pronunciation and Accent Reduction: I focus on clear communication, helping students reduce their accent or improve their pronunciation based on their specific needs.

My lessons are 30 minutes to an hour-long. They are divided into 4 sections: 
Reading and comprehension questions and discussion. 

Teaching style - Delegation, it's important for me to encourage my learner's capability and commend their efforts. I find that giving compliments to students when they do well boosts their confidence and encourages them to go beyond the average standard of achievement.

Using words as our weapons, we fight raging wars that continue to ravage our societies. 
Poverty, extortion, colonization, disease, these are all wars being fought with a pen.  
We live in an information society that thrives on communication, the exchange of words is what makes the financial industries, religious sectors, educational, entertainment, and many other sectors all possible.
